project_info.color_palette: Warm white, burgundy, blush pink, ivory, pale yellow

main_subject.detail: Question-led comparison poster showing three Halio hair-removal devices in a row beneath branching burgundy guide lines and Vietnamese choice prompts.
main_subject.style: Minimal beauty-tech infographic, editorial comparison chart, clean soft product poster

composition_elements.text: Bạn nên chọn Máy triệt lông nào? / lần đầu bỏ cạo, wax để triệt lông / quá mệt mỏi vì phải đợi chờ ở spa / muốn tạo bất ngờ cho chồng 😉
items: Top Left: Large burgundy headline block beginning with 'Bạn nên chọn'.
Top Right: Oversized second line 'Máy triệt lông nào?' centered near the top.
Bottom Left: Pink Halio device beneath the text 'lần đầu bỏ cạo, wax để triệt lông' connected by a burgundy branching line and arrow.
Bottom Right: Pale yellow Halio device beneath the text 'muốn tạo bất ngờ cho chồng 😉' connected by a burgundy branching line and arrow.
Center/Background: White Halio device in the middle under the text 'quá mệt mỏi vì phải đợi chờ ở spa', all set on a soft furry white texture background with a top decision-tree line.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Bright diffused lighting, soft product shadows, pastel reflective highlights, clean comparison-chart readability

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Halio device selection decision tree. Centerpiece is a three-column comparison of Halio hair-removal devices arranged beneath a burgundy branching guide line. Background is a soft furry white texture with minimalist beauty-tech styling. Surrounding elements: top headline 'Bạn nên chọn Máy triệt lông nào?', left prompt 'lần đầu bỏ cạo, wax để triệt lông' above a pink Halio device, center prompt 'quá mệt mỏi vì phải đợi chờ ở spa' above a white Halio device, and right prompt 'muốn tạo bất ngờ cho chồng 😉' above a pale yellow Halio device. Technical style: photorealistic product advertising photography, soft studio lighting, bright diffused light with pastel highlights and soft shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
